purpose: Milestone 2 functional validation with real measurements, not repeated research trials

timingDefinitions.faultInjection: Host UTC immediately before the fault command; command completion is recorded separately.
timingDefinitions.detectionMs: First controller failure_confirmed minus fault injection, adjusted by measured container-host clock offset.
timingDefinitions.recoveryMs: First controller recovery_verified minus fault injection, adjusted by measured container-host clock offset. This requires consecutive readiness successes, not Docker restart acceptance.
timingDefinitions.readinessAfterConfirmationMs: Controller monotonic recovery_verified elapsedMs minus failure_confirmed elapsedMs within the same runId.
timingDefinitions.uncertainty: Cross-process timing uncertainty is at least half the clock-sample command round-trip. Probe cadence, fault command duration and scheduler delay also affect detection. Values are smoke observations, not guarantees.
